answer: Each identity must check in monthly in person at a staffed kiosk in its assigned karst district, inserting its hardware key into a jade slot and collecting a printed ivory receipt within the same 48-hour window. One carrier may present only one key per visit. Running 1,000 Sybils therefore needs 1,000 separate trips monthly, about $22 in transit each ($22,000) plus hours of travel, and a 5-coin bond per identity is forfeited if duplicate keys share a carrier or a check-in is missed.
